summary.text: An 18-hole championship course beside the Lagoa de Óbidos, designed by Donald Steel and inaugurated in September 2008.

setting.text: Occupies more than 60 hectares at the Bom Sucesso Resort, next to the Lagoa de Óbidos, with views of the lagoon.
The first nine is on relatively level ground, and the back nine rises and falls over more undulating land.
Sits within a large residential development close to the Silver Coast, about an hour north of Lisbon.
Combines long greens, lakes and strategically placed bunkers in the manner of classic courses.

history.text: Martin Ebert laid out the fairways when he was one of the lead architects with Donald Steel's design company.
Top100golfcourses says many of the design elements nod to old classic layouts, such as building some randomness into the green surfaces and surrounds.
Added to the European Tour Destinations list in April 2016.

trivia.text: Top100golfcourses lists the architects as Donald Steel, Mackenzie & Ebert.

2.text: A par 5 that doglegs right with a lake on the right, so the approach to the green has to be accurate.

16.text: A tough, uphill par 4 that opens the closing stretch, with panoramic views of the surrounding area.

17.text: A par 5 that swings downhill on a left dogleg to a far-off green about 530 metres from the back tees, according to Top100golfcourses.
The club calls it the most exciting hole, with superb views of the Óbidos Lagoon and steeply sloping ground down the left.

18.text: A par 4 that heads back to the clubhouse, crossing a stream and with a pond fronting the green.
The club says the clubhouse terrace overlooks the 18th.

local.text: Beside the Lagoa de Óbidos, about an hour from Lisbon airport.
The resort also has a hotel and spa, and designer homes.
Praia D'El Rey, Royal Óbidos and West Cliffs are all nearby.
The medieval walled town of Óbidos is close by.
